description: A drastic refit based on the Gravastar-class hull, the Efreet-class is a standardized modernization shared between many different hardliner groups. Gravistar-class hulls handed to the fledging Hardliner groups were deemed inefficient by captains due to their age, resulting in the creation of the new Efreet-class. A simple conversion of aging systems and application of exterior armor paired with weapon mounts satisfied the children of Gorlex, a brutally dark exterior to remind them of their history. the Efreet quickly gained fame among Hardliners due to its advanced cloaking, when an undetectable fleet of Efreets razed a notorious independent company's mining operation to the ground.
